title: Body Work
pitch: The Calloways' driver has the keys to a dented car and Victor's fee for fixing it. He thinks he's being set up. Get both.

clue_a.label: The fountain
lines: Silver paint scraped along the fountain's rim, chest height. The car hit stone, not a person. Nobody got hurt.

clue_b.label: The silver saloon
lines: Driver's seat racked all the way back. Danny's a head shorter than whoever drove it last.
